name: Vesselwaterarea Pattern
description: to represent a direct relation between vessel types and water areas regardless of what type of fishing gear is fitted
scenarios: in which water areas are 'gillneters' used?
competency_questions: which vessel types can be used in which water areas? (provided that water areas have species that are caught by geartypes that are used by vessel types)
